inputs.vref_source: WeAct 主控板 3.3 V 经 10 kΩ/10 kΩ 分压得到；不取 DRV8262 DVDD
inputs.single_bridge_ipropi_connection: IPROPI1 与 IPROPI2 相连；连接点仅接一个 RIPROPI 至 GND

thermal_assumptions.duty_for_thermal_estimate: conduction model uses motor RMS current; switching estimate uses TI PSW=VM*I*trf*f formula

thermal_estimate_20khz_3arms_at_37_8v.interpretation: 约1.25 W 为热态典型导通电阻估算值与典型开关/静态损耗相加；不是最坏值。RθJA仅对应 TI 指定 JEDEC 板条件，实际值依 PCB 铜面积、层数和热过孔变化。

formula_notes: ITRIP = VREF / (RIPROPI × AIPROPI); single mode ties IPROPI pins and uses one resistor, so gain remains 212 µA/A against total motor current.
VREF = 3.3 V × 10 kΩ / (10 kΩ + 10 kΩ) = 1.65 V; source is the WeAct board 3V3 rail, not DRV8262 DVDD.
Dideal = 21 V / VBUS; use as an ideal duty ceiling estimate, then validate using motor-terminal voltage and actual bus voltage.
Pcond ≈ Irms² × (RHS + RLS); for this estimate both hot FETs use 43 mΩ.
Pdead ≈ 2 × VD × I × tD × fPWM; Pswitch ≈ VM × I × tRF × fPWM; Pq ≈ VM × IVM.
The 5.19 A trip point is nominal only. Mirror gain accuracy, reference and resistor tolerances mean it is not a guaranteed 5 A hard ceiling; it does not current-limit commanded high-side braking.
